BounceSprGfx.name: Draw bounce sprite, check coin tile
summary: $0291F8: draws bounce sprite [$1698] as one 16x16 OAM tile (position relative to the camera of its layer, tile from BounceSpriteTiles).
Returns without drawing if the sprite is off-screen.
$029265: finds the Map16 tile at the bounce sprite. If it is a coin ($002B) the coin is removed (tile type 9 generated) and a
spinning coin is spawned ($029356, uses a free slot of [$17D0]-[$17D3]), as when hitting a block with a coin above it.
Parameters: X: bounce sprite slot.

s029392.name: Table: X speed of knocked sprite
summary: $F8 (left), $08 (right), indexed by the side of Mario.

s029394.name: Bounce block and cape hit sprites
summary: $029394: frees a bounce slot. $029398: per-frame bounce block interaction. Counts down [$18F8,X]; in the last 2 frames checks every
sprite (X = $0B-0) against the bounce hitbox, or the cape hitbox when $0E is non-zero ($0293AE), and hits them with CODE_029404.
$029404: knocks one sprite: 8 frame interaction lockout, kill with score, stunned (status 9) if it can be jumped on, Y speed up,
X speed away from Mario. Special cases: changing item ($81), baby Yoshi, Bob-omb, Lakitu.
Parameters: X: sprite slot, $0E: 0 = bounce block, $35 = ground pound, other = cape.

GroundPound.name: Ground pound: shake ground
summary: Called by Mario's code (JSL from $00EFB2). Sets the ground shake timer [$1887] = $30, then hits every grounded sprite.
Falls into KillSprLoopStart.

KillSprLoopStart.name: Ground pound: hit grounded sprites
summary: For sprite slots 9 to 0: skips dead sprites, sprites in the air, sprites that cannot be killed by the cape/are eaten/have
interaction disabled; the others are hit with $0E = $35 through CODE_029404.

GroundPoundNextSpr.name: Ground pound loop end; cape interaction
summary: $0294F0: next sprite of the ground pound loop, restores the data bank and returns long.
$0294F5: cape interaction. Does nothing unless [$13E8] is set. On odd frames hits sprites and extended sprites; every frame
tests the Map16 tile at the cape ($02950B), also on layer 2 if bit 7 of [$5B] is set.

s02953C.name: Table: cape test point Y offsets
summary: Y offsets +8, +8 for the two points the cape tests alternately.

s029540.name: Cape hits block and extended sprites
summary: $029540: tests one point of the cape ([$13E9]-[$13EC] plus offset, chosen by frame counter bit 0) against the Map16 map of layer [$0F]:
builds a pointer into $7E/$7F, calls CODE_00F545 and, if the tile reacts, CODE_00F160 (block hit by cape). Sets RAM_BlockX/Y for it.
$029631: loops over extended sprites 7-0, hitting those that touch the cape (except number < 2 and $12).

s029657.name: Table: bounce block hitbox offsets
summary: Overlapping tables read as Return029656+status by CODE_029663: X offset (16-bit), width, Y offset (16-bit), height for status 1 and 2.

s029663.name: Bounce block and cape hitboxes
summary: $029663: builds hitbox B ($00 X low, $08 X high, $02 width, $01 Y low, $09 Y high, $03 height) from bounce block slot Y.
$029696: same for the cape: X-2, width $14, height $10.
Parameters: Y: bounce slot (for $029663).

s0296B8.name: Table: smoke sprite OAM offsets
summary: Two groups of four OAM indexes, apparently used by the smoke sprite code.

s0296C0.name: Run smoke sprite by type
summary: Runs the routine for smoke sprite slot X by type [$17C0,X] AND $7F via the pointer table below. Returns if the slot is free.
Parameters: X: smoke sprite slot.

Ptrs0296CB.name: Pointer table: smoke sprite routines
summary: Indexed by smoke type 0-5.

s0296D8.name: Table: smoke animation tiles
summary: Probably tile numbers of the smoke puff animation.
